headline: Found a bug? Got an idea? Tell me!
t:
📌 Found a bug or got an idea for The Arcade? I want to hear it!

👉 Fill in the form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeOQOSz6bS6-2aBxjDZSSdxpBYECQlmbnOWhmeAk34R3wU-7g/viewform

🐞 Bugs: tell me which game, what happened and what device you were on
💡 Ideas: new games, modes, maps, features, anything you want to see

Every answer gets read, and the best ideas end up in a future update (you will see the post about it right here) 🙌

#TheArcade #Feedback

headline: Feedback is now on the home page
t:
📣 You can now send feedback straight from the home page!

👇 Scroll to the bottom of the Games tab and tap "Send feedback". Or use the link right here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeOQOSz6bS6-2aBxjDZSSdxpBYECQlmbnOWhmeAk34R3wU-7g/viewform

🐞 Spotted a bug? Tell me which game, what happened and what device you were on
💡 Want a new game, mode or map? Drop the idea in

I read every answer, and the fixes and ideas show up here as posts when they ship 🙌

#TheArcade #Feedback

headline: We have moved to thearcade.pages.dev
t:
🚚 The Arcade has a new home!

👉 https://thearcade.pages.dev

🌐 Online play has moved over there: from today, online games only work on the new site.
📅 The old site (noah-and-lars.github.io) shuts down on November 17.
💾 All your progress migrates over. Just log in on the new site with your Arcade account. No account yet? Make one on the old site first so your progress comes with you.

See you there! 🎮

#TheArcade #NewSite
